name: Wiza
summary: Reveal emails and phones from profile URLs or names, enrich companies, and search prospects.

api_key.description: A Wiza API key (Wiza account > API; see the Generate an API Key page). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Reveals are asynchronous: start, then poll the get endpoint or use a webhook.
Credits are prepaid and deducted only when data comes back.
The legacy list endpoints (create list, get list contacts, prospect lists) and the location and technology autocomplete lookups are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Email, phone, export and API credits left.
notes: email_credits and phone_credits can be the string "unlimited".

endpoints.name: Start an individual reveal
endpoints.summary: Enrich one contact from a profile URL, a name plus company or domain, or an email. Returns an id to poll.

individual_reveal.description: One of: {profile_url}; {full_name, company or domain, optional profile_url, email}; {email}.

email_options.description: {accept_work, accept_personal} booleans; all emails returned when omitted.

callback_url.description: Webhook that overrides the account default.

notes: Starts a job that only produces data (it does spend credits). Poll wiza.reveal.get with data.id until is_complete; status goes queued, resolving, finished or failed. A 429 means the queue is full.

Credits are charged only for data returned: profile matched 1 API credit, valid email 2, phone 5 (full is phones plus emails, each when returned). The credit-behavior page names the levels none, email, phone and full while this reference lists none, partial, phone and full.

endpoints.name: Get an individual reveal
endpoints.summary: Status and results of a reveal.
notes: data.credits shows the credits used. 404 when the id is unknown.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company
endpoints.summary: Company data by name, domain or LinkedIn id or slug (at least one).

company_linkedin_slug.description: Slug from the LinkedIn company URL.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
2 API credits per request, charged only when company data is found.

endpoints.name: Search prospects
endpoints.summary: People matching person and company filters; returns up to 30 profiles per call.

filters.description: Filter object. Person: first_name, last_name, job_title [{v, s: i|e}], job_title_level, job_role, location [{v, b, s}], skill, school, years_of_experience_min/max, last_role_change. Company: job_company, company_industry, company_size, company_type, revenue, technologies, funding_stage, year_founded_start/end and more. Enum values are listed in the docs.

size.description: Profiles to return, default 0, max 30. 0 returns just counts.

notes: A read over POST: nothing in your account is changed.
Billed in API credits only for profiles returned; the docs give no per-profile rate. Included location and radius filters are OR-ed.
